rationale: The agent authenticated the user via matching email before accessing or changing account data. It identified the correct delivered order containing the bookshelf and jigsaw puzzle, correctly explained that cancellation wasn’t possible post-delivery, and obtained explicit confirmation before submitting the return for both items. It then located the delivered order containing the backpack and vacuum cleaner and, after explicit confirmation, submitted the backpack return. For the pending order, the agent verified the order details, checked product variants, summarized the exact address and item-color changes including price difference and payment method, obtained explicit confirmation, and then executed the address and item modification appropriately. All actions were performed on the authenticated user’s account with the correct payment method. Finally, when asked for a tracking number for a canceled order, the agent correctly stated that canceled orders do not have tracking numbers. No writes were performed without confirmation, no unsupported claims were made, and no policy violations were observed.
